verify.note: Measures the CONSEQUENCE, never the row's title, across the whole path a price travels: (1) the card renders its price stat CONDITIONALLY and its prop accepts a withheld one; (2) none of the three EventCard call sites defaults a withheld price back to a value -- the negative that a re-added ?? 'Free' would trip, and the half that proves the withholding actually reaches a render; (3) both loaders BRANCH on buyerMaySeePrice and actually resolve readiness, so the verdict is not running on nothing; (4) the Offer and isAccessibleForFree sit UNDER the unsellable branch in lib/jsonld.ts, by source position, which is the ordering a refactor would silently undo; (5) the crawlable faces supply the verdict; (6) the bespoke "the host hasn’t opened ticket sales" sentence is GONE and TICKETS_NOT_READY stands on both unbuyable branches; (7) the resolver goes through canSellTickets, which is the dead-export half of the finding; (8) the Space event popup asks whether there is a ticket to get before offering Get tickets. 'Free' resurrected, each loader losing its branch, the schema losing its read, the crawl face losing its ask, the bespoke sentence returning, the resolver bypassing canSellTickets, and the popup offering Get tickets regardless -- each failed as it must, and the clean tree passes.
